name: Research and review
goal: Research {{input}} and prepare a source-linked draft

nodes.title: Research
nodes.instructions: Research {{input}}. Find relevant sources, read supporting pages and retain evidence limits.

nodes.title: Draft
nodes.instructions: Write a useful draft from the retained findings. Cite source URLs, disclose uncertainty and do not publish.

nodes.title: Review
nodes.instructions: Review the draft against the goal and retained sources. Reply text must be JSON with verdict PASS or REVISE and changes. Never execute external writes.
